buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Buyer Added Terms and Conditions (ATC) 1. Mandatory site visit and measurements. Each bidder shall visit the installation site before submitting its bid, in coordination with the Buyer’s designated representative. The bi dder shall measure the installation locations for the 3D LED backlit board, customised back lit logo and illuminated mirror. The bidder shall also verify the mounting surfaces, access cl earances, electrical supply points, and the water supply and drainage arrangements for the washing machine and water purifiers. The bidder shall submit a site visit and measurement record acknowledged by the Buyer’s representative with its technical bid. Failure to comple te the site visit or submit the acknowledged record shall result in technical disqualification. 2. Mandatory design, material samples and approval. The bidder shall submit dimen sioned drawings for the board, logo and mirror with its technical bid and present represent ative samples of the proposed materials and finishes during technical evaluation. The Buye r shall communicate the sample presentation schedule to all bidders. The board and logo dr awings shall show the lettering, artwork, colours, illumination and mounting details. The mi rror drawing shall show the dimensions, edge finish, lighting and fixing arrangement. The B uyer shall assess the submissions against the published bid specifications and the recorded site measurements. Failure to present the required designs or samples, or failure to obtain written approval because the designs or samples do not meet those requirements, shall res ult in technical disqualification. The successful bidder shall fabricate and install the items in accordance with the approved designs and samples. 3. 3D LED backlit Board - The successful bidder shall fabricate and install the board to th e dimensions stated in the bid item schedule, with the layout and fixing details verified duri ng the site visit. The board shall reproduce the Buyer-approved wording and artwork. The p anel, lettering, frame, fixings and exposed electrical components shall be suitable for outdo or installation. The board shall be securely mounted without obstructing gate operation or a ccess. At final inspection, the lettering shall be legible and evenly backlit, with no visible fli

cker or unlit sections. 4. Customised backlit logo - The successful bidder shall fabricate and install the logo usi ng the artwork approved by the Buyer. The finished logo shall match the approved proporti ons, colours, dimensions and placement. The logo shall be securely mounted, and the backl ighting shall be even and free from visible flicker or unlit sections. 5. Washing machine - The bidder shall identify the make and model offered and submit t he manufacturer’s product datasheet showing compliance with the bid item specifications. The successful bidder shall install and level the washing machine, connect it to the designa ted water, drainage and electrical points, and demonstrate a complete wash cycle, includin g filling, draining and spinning, without leakage. 6. Water purifier, 50 litres per hour - The bidder shall identify the make and model offe red and submit the manufacturer’s datasheet confirming a rated purified-water output of 5 0 litres per hour per unit, together with the specified inlet water and pressure conditions. T he successful bidder shall connect, flush and commission both units. During final inspection , the successful bidder shall demonstrate leak-free operation and verify the purified-water o utput of each unit by timed collection under the manufacturer’s specified operating conditi ons. 7. Looking mirror Big with accessories - The successful bidder shall supply and install t he mirror to the dimensions and design approved after site measurement. The mirror shall be free from cracks, chips and visible reflection distortion. The edges shall be finished, the mirror shall be securely fixed, and the lighting shall operate evenly without visible flicker. T he successful bidder shall supply the accessories listed under the mirror item in the bid sch edule. 8. Installation, testing and handover. The successful bidder shall protect existing surfa ces and services during installation, make good any damage caused by the work, and remo ve installation debris. Final acceptance shall follow successful inspection and demonstratio n of all five line items, including both water purifiers. The successful bidder shall rectify def ects identified during inspection at its own cost and hand over the applicable operating inst ructions and warranty documents. .
